Infallora

A local video downloader built with Rust, Tauri, yt-dlp and ffmpeg. Version 0.2.2. No account, no telemetry, no cloud.

It uses yt-dlp under the hood, so it supports thousands of video and social sites.

For private or members-only videos, export cookies.txt from your signed-in browser and place it next to Infallora.exe. Infallora picks it up automatically — no setup needed for public videos.
